name: Etra
short_description:
Etra – A Fantasy Total Conversion Mod (Alpha 0.0.7)

Etra – A Fantasy Total Conversion Mod [Alpha 0.01]

Dive into the fantasy world of Etra, a single-developer fantasy EU5 mod where empires rise, fall, and clash in endless ambition. This release is intended to be a vertical slice of the mod, giving a taste of the factions, mechanics, and stories that await in future updates. Join me in this journey and shape the fate of a world. The mod is currently fully playable but is currently light on content, on the bright side if you have a slower computer, gets EU5 to run fast.

Lore Overview:
At least Thrice has the World perished. Once by the Flame, once by Frost, once again by Steel. Very nearly a fourth time: During an event known as The Day, a magical cataclysm erupted and scared the world, birthed and stopped by unknown hands. In nearly two hundred years since that day, the world has slowly been re-built, and now that cataclysm slowly passes into myths and memories. The inhabitants of the world have continued as they have ad nauseam, dying, living, hating, loving, killing. As an indifferent sun rises on an unfamiliar world, the world enters an age similar to our own’s early modern era.
